[ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-try dishes in Seoul include kimchi, bibimbap, jeyuk bokkeum, bulgogi, naengmyeon, tteokbokki, and mandu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Seoul include Gwangjang Market, Tosokchon Samgyetang, Jongno Sikdang, Hanilkwan, Myeongdong Kyoja, Jinju Hoegwan, and Yukhoe.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting restaurants include visiting during off-peak hours, trying new dishes, and being prepared for spicy food.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended language exchange programs include Language Exchange Korea, Seoul Global Center, and Korea University Language Exchange Program.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended language exchange apps include HelloTalk, Tandem, and iTalki.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested websites and online communities include Korea Forum, Reddit's r/LearnKorean, and Korean Language Exchange Facebook Groups.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended meetup groups include Seoul Language Exchange Meetup and Korean Language Exchange Meetup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for language exchange include being respectful, setting clear goals, practicing active listening, and not being afraid to make mistakes.
